description: Source code for a class that writes build rules for Rust binary targets in Ninja build system, including dependency classification, variable writing, and command generation.

classes.name: NinjaRustBinaryTargetWriter

methods.name: GetFlagOptions
methods.description: Returns escape options configured for writing compiler and linker flags.

methods.name: WriteVar
methods.description: Outputs a variable assignment to the build file with proper escaping.

methods.description: Main method to generate build rules for the Rust binary target, including dependencies, compiler variables, and command invocation.

methods.description: Adds source files and inputs to the list of implicit dependencies.

methods.name: WriteSourcesAndInputs
methods.description: Outputs source files and input data to the build rule.
